description: Ministry of Telecommunication & Digital Infrastructure - Functions of the subjects assigned to Deputy Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure
categorisation: This gazette notification assigns specific functions and duties (monitoring/evaluation of projects, implementation of computer literacy programs, labor relations, and IT park development) to the Deputy Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure. It describes structural/administrative changes in government responsibilities without naming any specific individuals (only the minister's signature is present, but no personnel changes are announced). This fits the definition of Organisational Gazette (Type 1) as it involves assignment of functions and portfolio responsibilities without personnel appointments.
